conditions.runtime: client connected to dedicated SMP with Xaero installed

change.summary: Xaero owns GuiMap construction, camera, controls and waypoint actions; the only JEM screen extension is the approved settlement boundary and owner expansion action

before.value: JEM MapScreen, WaypointMenu and WaypointTeleport Mixins added overlays, menu actions and native waypoint teleport cancellation

after.value: No broad JEM GuiMap replacement or waypoint interception; only thin settlement boundaries and owner-only preview/confirm expansion are appended

before.value: JEM constructed and reflectively centered GuiMap from profile and campaign locator flows

after.value: Only Xaero's native ControlsHandler opens GuiMap; JEM does not construct, center or mutate the screen

rationale.purpose: Keep Xaero's screen construction, presentation, camera and actions entirely native while retaining narrow data sharing adapters.
rationale.decision_source: Direct user runtime corrections on2026-10-14 that Xaero remained overhauled and that JEM's Xaero screen must also be removed; native ControlsHandler invocation was selected from exact installed Xaero 1.46.0 bytecode evidence.

introduced.summary: User approved spec/plans, native inline execution and push; source implementation only, not built or played.

history.summary: User approved spec/plans, native inline execution and push; source implementation only, not built or played.
Disabled JEM MapScreen, WaypointMenu and WaypointTeleport Mixins and removed the unused JEM map-layer client config registration; native shared terrain/full-cave and boss marker adapters remain.

Deleted the disabled JEM Xaero screen/menu/action Mixin sources, their MapView bridge and JEMTwelveEyes' reflective XaeroBossMapScreen; profile and locator flows now call Xaero's native open-map control without screen construction or camera mutation.

User-approved Settlements Update 1 restores only a tail-rendered settlement outline and one owner-only preview/confirm right-click action; projects, events and personal waypoint actions remain outside the Mixin.

relations: native producer -> server authoritative state -> synchronized client presentation
notes: No native GUI/resource replacement, terrain/boss sharing change, permissions mutation or world-space event wall change.
Locator coordinates are shown as a normal client message because JEM no longer controls Xaero's dimension or camera.
JEM no longer registers jem-map-layers-client.toml; settlement boundaries are always visible by explicit user decision and cannot expose personal waypoint data.
unresolved: Fresh artifacts load on the dedicated server and contain none of the deleted screen classes; player-rendered acceptance remains pending.
